definitions.explanation: The act of briefly closing and opening the eyes.
The flickering or sparkling of stars, lights, or other luminous objects.

definitions.gloss: instant; moment; blink of an eye
definitions.explanation: A very brief period of time, used figuratively to describe how quickly something happened.

examples.english: That decision was made in the blink of an eye, but I came to regret it later.

notes:
From the verb ⟦{瞬|またた}く→瞬く：04385_matataku⟧ (to blink; to twinkle). The three senses are all connected through the idea of something brief and flickering. The expression ⟦{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に→瞬く間に：21215_matatakumani⟧ (in the twinkling of an eye) is literary and emphatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞬|またた}きもしない: not even blink (from concentration or shock)
- ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{瞬|またた}き: the twinkling of stars
- ⟦{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に→瞬く間に：21215_matatakumani⟧: in the blink of an eye; in an instant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- まばたき: blink — the more common everyday word for blinking the eyes; same kanji {瞬|まばた}き
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧: an instant — same kanji {瞬|しゅん}; the most common word for "a moment"
- きらめき: sparkle; glitter — emphasizes brilliance and beauty more than flickering
